pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: A search that matches nothing costs an extra COUNT(*) query. The `empty` parameter is also interpolated into the page as raw HTML, so a future caller passing unescaped text would be an injection risk.
findings.fix: Optional: pass a flag or a pre-escaped message type to `page`, or note in a comment that `empty` must be pre-escaped.

lenses.note: This is a small bug fix with one obvious design. The change does what the title says, and nothing beyond it.
No spec file in this change.

`npm test` could not run here because vitest is not installed. By reading, the three new tests would fail against the old code. They cover a no-match search, escaping of the search text, and the empty-table case. The empty-table test deletes all rows, but it is the last test in the file.
The diff touches no docs files, and no doc describes the empty message.
The logic is correct. The search text is escaped before it is interpolated, and the empty-table case still gives 'No items yet.'.
The user-supplied search text is escaped with `escapeHtml` and the test covers it. The SQL is parameterized.
The diff changes only message text, with no layout or style changes.
The diff changes only message text. The PR states no browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: the escaped message, the empty-table message, no tests deleted or loosened, and the new tests.
